title: Valentine Archuleta sees the craft hit the mesa
place_text: Archuleta ranch, near Aztec, New Mexico

tellings.quote: So he looked up and he saw it and he saw it hit right here.

plain: The granddaughter of a rancher named Valentine Archuleta says her grandfather looked up and saw a craft come down and hit a mesa, a flat-topped hill, right on his family's land near Aztec, New Mexico, around March 25, 1948. Her account is part of a larger story about a crash there, which others tie to a police officer chasing a disc and a small helicopter circling the site. If true, it would mean a local man saw the crash itself.
